Refund Policy

Last updated: September 28, 2026 · Questions: support@getadversaryai.com

Monthly plans

You can cancel any time and keep access until the end of the current billing period. If you're new to a paid plan and you've used fewer than 20 rounds, email us within 7 days of your first charge and we'll refund it in full.

Round packs

Unused packs are refundable within 14 days of purchase. Once rounds from a pack have been used, the pack is non-refundable.

Service problems

If an outage or a bug on our side stops a session from working, that round isn't charged. If you were charged for something you couldn't use, tell us and we'll credit it back.

How to request a refund

Email support@getadversaryai.com from your account email. Refunds go back to the original payment method and usually appear within 5–10 business days.
